hypothesis: Reproduce the upstream training-row sequence without transformer inference, establishing diagnostic data and prompt coverage before changing training or allocating training compute.
acceptance: Source copies and training patch match the previously verified preparation build
Full row dump exactly matches the published upstream bytes and SHA-256
Zone and match rasters each have 552750204 bytes
Successful execution reports the complete coded stream byte count
output_policy: Keep large raw diagnostic files local; commit protocols, source/binary/input/output hashes, logs and summaries, including failures.
scope: Training and prompt diagnostics only. Constant-prediction output is intentionally not a usable compressed archive. No GPU training, new model or prize-score claim.
limitations: The no-inference dump cannot evaluate model likelihood or the effect of a prompt change on compression.
The full dump contains target-corpus data and does not create an untouched validation set.
A subsequent training experiment needs its own frozen objective, data, exported model-cost accounting and complete coder comparisons.
